import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
s=pd.read_csv('/workspace/battery_all_summaries.csv')
d=pd.read_csv('/workspace/battery_all_doses.csv')
# Key block C 45 and block E tap 45 associations
c45=s[(s.block=='C')&(s.tilt_deg==45)].set_index('powder_id')['mean_g']*1000
t45=s[(s.block=='E')&(s.tilt_deg==45)&(s.phase=='tap')].set_index('powder_id')['mean_g']*1000
common=c45.index.intersection(t45.index)
print('feed/tap table mg')
print(pd.DataFrame({'feed45_mg_rev':c45[common], 'tap45_mg':t45[common]}).sort_values('feed45_mg_rev'))
for kind in ['pearson','spearman']:
 r,p=getattr(stats,kind+'r')(c45[common], t45[common])
 print(kind,r,p)
# Dose summaries, CI t (descriptive only)
g=d.groupby('powder_id').agg(mean_error_g=('error_g','mean'),sd_error_g=('error_g','std'),mean_disp=('dispensed_g','mean'),sd_disp=('dispensed_g','std'),n=('error_g','size'))
g['mean_error_mg']=1000*g.mean_error_g; g['sd_error_mg']=1000*g.sd_error_g
g['ci_half_mg']=stats.t.ppf(.975,2)*g.sd_error_mg/np.sqrt(3)
g['rsd_disp_pct']=100*g.sd_disp/g.mean_disp
print('\ndose summary')
print(g[['mean_error_mg','sd_error_mg','ci_half_mg','rsd_disp_pct']].round(2))
# feed vs absolute mean error, excluding brown maybe all
abs_err=g['mean_error_mg'].abs()
x=c45.reindex(g.index)
for maskname,mask in [('all',np.ones(len(g),dtype=bool)),('excluding brown',g.index!='brown-rice-flour')]:
 print('\n',maskname)
 for kind in ['pearson','spearman']:
  r,p=getattr(stats,kind+'r')(x[mask],abs_err[mask]); print(kind,r,p)
# block C vs E refeed ratios at 45
ref45=s[(s.block=='E')&(s.tilt_deg==45)&(s.phase=='refeed')].set_index('powder_id')['mean_g']*1000
rat=(ref45/c45).sort_values()
print('\nE/C ratio 45',rat)
# static upper CI heuristic: each hold one delta only, all zero.
# Tap t CIs
rows=[]
for _,r in s[(s.block=='E')&(s.phase=='tap')].iterrows():
 half=stats.t.ppf(.975,r['n']-1)*r['sem_g']*1000
 rows.append([r.powder_id,r.tilt_deg,r.mean_g*1000,half,r.rsd_pct])
print('\ntap means CI mg')
print(pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=['powder','tilt','mean_mg','cihalf_mg','rsd']).round(3).to_string(index=False))

# Quantify two additional descriptive contrasts used in the review.
import numpy as np
# CMC 90° values supplied in the digest
cmc90=np.array([39.0,7.4,4.0,1.8,1.4,2.5])
print('CMC 90 first mg:',cmc90[0])
print('CMC 90 remaining mean mg:',cmc90[1:].mean())
print('first/remain ratio:',cmc90[0]/cmc90[1:].mean())
print('remaining five SD and RSD:',cmc90[1:].std(ddof=1),100*cmc90[1:].std(ddof=1)/cmc90[1:].mean())
# Range expressed in decimal orders using observed block-C means.
mx=232.25; lows=[0.30,0.25,0.20]
for lo in lows:
 print(f'{mx}/{lo}={mx/lo:.1f}x, log10={np.log10(mx/lo):.3f}')
# Exact binomial interval for 0 detectable events in 21 static holds, as a descriptive bound
from scipy.stats import beta
upper=beta.ppf(.975,1,21) # two-sided CP upper when x=0
print('CP two-sided 95% upper event probability, 0/21:',upper)
